answer: Coordination Terrace Pricing: each agent pays a per-period fee equal to the square root of its simultaneous open coordination slots; fees fund a shared grove of audited public logs. An identity without counterparties still pays the base slot, so N fake agents cost N base fees per period, and cross-slot messaging adds Comet-style relay charges that scale with fan-out. Attacker cost is continuous rent on every identity before any vote or trade lands, making mass low-value sybils unprofitable.
